policies.text: Diplomatic travel missions are assigned to enterprise carriers with major scale contract clearance.
Standard quality assurance recognition is accorded to any provider maintaining ISO 9001 certification.
Authorization for high-capacity operations requires elite vendor standing combined with liquid corporate reserves reaching at least 1500000 USD.
Premium carrier status is awarded to a fleet-scale operator whose yearly safety audit rating is 90 percent or higher.
An operator receives fleet-scale classification provided their active charter aircraft tally reaches 10 units or more.
Logistics provider eligibility nationwide requires a minimum commercial vehicle fleet size of 30 trucks.
Vendor designation at the elite level is conferred on any organization possessing premium carrier status.
Deep-sea harbor access is granted to shipping companies maintaining an annual container volume above 1000000 TEU.
Express rail service privileges require a punctual arrival percentage of at least 98 percent over the preceding quarter.
Approval for regional territory expansion is granted to transit operators carrying a yearly passenger count exceeding 400000 travelers.
